We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for this case. Facts: The defendant (何2某臣) is the plaintiff (actually the one who made accusations). He is being sued (self-suit?) by self? So the charge is defamation (诽谤罪). In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "诽谤罪". The description: He spread false statements that the party secretary beat him, causing serious damage to reputation. So the appropriate charge: 诽谤罪.

Check if any other charges: He also had prior administrative detention for disturbing public order, but that's not a criminal charge now. The case is about defamation. So single charge: 诽谤.
